symptoms: Renal and biliary colic or acute surgical abdomen

management_steps.details: IM: 5-10 mg. IV: Dilute 10 mg up to 10 mL with sodium chloride, 0.9%.

IM: 5-10 mg (Doctor prescribed), may be repeated after 4-6 hours if needed or until patient is referred. IV: Administer 3-5 mg as a single dose, then further boluses of 1-2 mg/minute. Total maximum as a single dose: 10 mg. Repeat after 4 hours if needed or until patient is referred.
Monitor response to pain and effects on respiration and BP. Doctor prescribed.
